desc: The Mendeleev Ridge or Mendeleev Rise is a broad ridge in the Arctic Ocean from the East Siberian Sea area of the Siberian Shelf to the central areas of the ocean. It is named after Dmitri Mendeleyev. The Ridge was discovered in 1948 by Soviet high latitude expeditions.
fact: The Ridge was discovered in 1948 by Soviet high latitude expeditions · The name was approved by the Sub-Committee on Geographical Names and Nomenclature of Ocean Bottom Features in April 1987
